mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% signals strengthening economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite strong GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low FEDFUNDS rate (< 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in UNRATE below 4% signals a tightening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to expected rate hikes.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite low unemployment.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO exceeding 1.5% signals strengthening industrial production, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward correlation between INDPRO and SPX returns remains below 0.2 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint behavior of HOUST and RSAFS, where both increase by more than 5% month-over-month, signals robust demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both increase > 5% MoM
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite strong demand signals.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in FEDFUNDS by more than 0.5% in one month signals a monetary policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: PAYEMS growth rate outpacing UNRATE decline rate signals labor market strength, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 55% of instances despite favorable labor market conditions.

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: In a post-shock recovery regime, a 3% increase in GDPC1 signals sustained economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward correlation between GDPC1 and SPX returns in post-shock recovery regimes remains below 0.25 over any 1.5-year rolling window.
